resources.string: Engine
Shown while ArrowLoop is syncing in the background. Silent.
Finished runs
What a scheduled run copied, moved or put in the bin. Only when something changed.
Failed runs
A scheduled run that did not finish, and why. A sync that fails quietly is worse than one that fails loudly.
Anomalies
A job a safety brake holds until you decide, and the notes about a job that keeps failing or is overdue.

Ready to sync, and able to keep going while the screen is off.
